We therefore model every replica as a state machine that advances only through a totally ordered log, and we treat an inflight entry as provisional until a quorum of voters has persisted it. In our implementation the follower applies the entry lazily and reports its durable watermark back to the leader at intervals of at most one hundred milliseconds.
